Figure, problem, and page numbers in the lecture notes all refer to sections of the course textbook with relevant content.

Battin, Richard. An Introduction to the Mathematics and Methods of Astrodynamics. Revised ed. Reston, VA: AIAA, 1999. ISBN: 9781563473425.
